items.html: The second act is that she is compelled to brood over the chicks, and this is when her NHY clothe the Mochin of ZA, and enter within them to diminish their light; for without this clothing, ZA would not have been able to receive the Mochin and their great illumination, as explained in the discourse on the Priestly Blessing. For then it is the primary clothing of the Mochin in her, first, in the NHY of Ima.
